description: This file defines the TextFrameRenderer class responsible for rendering TextFrame objects to RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering shape properties, handling layout, and managing shape dimensions.

classes.name: TextFrameRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a TextFrame object to RTF format, handling shape properties, layout, and content rendering.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render a TextFrame to RTF, including shape properties and contained elements.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the shape, defaulting to 1 inch if not specified.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the shape, defaulting to 1 inch if not specified.

methods.name: RenderLayoutPicture
methods.description: Renders an invisible dummy picture for shape placement.

methods.name: StartDummyParagraph
methods.description: Begins a dummy paragraph to embed a shape.

methods.name: EndDummyParagraph
methods.description: Ends the dummy paragraph started for shape placement.
